# HTTP: endpoints, auth parameters and headers

<!-- Generated by tools/docs/generate.ts from the code registries. Do not edit; run `pnpm docs:gen`. -->

## Endpoints

| Endpoint | What it does | Query parameters (besides the map parameters) |
|---|---|---|
| GET `/v1/map` | Render a map from query parameters | — |
| POST `/v1/map` | Render a map from a JSON MapSpec | `response` |
| GET `/v1/map.{ext}` | Render a map; the extension picks the format | — |
| GET `/v1/images/{key}` | Fetch a cached image by content hash | — |
| GET `/v1/areas/search` | Search areas by name (with hierarchy context for disambiguation) | `q`, `limit` |
| GET `/v1/areas/{id}` | Get one area | — |
| GET `/v1/places/search` | Search named places (cities, peaks, mountain ranges…) | `q`, `limit` |

## Auth parameters

Accepted on every `/v1/map` request in addition to the map parameters. A server without API keys (`MINIMAPS_AUTH=none`, the self-hosted default) accepts and ignores them, so the same URLs work against both.

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `apikey` | Publishable key (`pk_…`) for `<img>` embeds. Only valid together with `sig`. Secret keys (`sk_…`) are rejected in URLs. | `apikey=pk_8fK2aQ1mZr9TbL0x4WcYvN3sHd7uJe6p` |
| `sig` | URL signature: HMAC-SHA256 of the canonical request with the key's signing secret (see the signing guide). Proves the URL was created by the key owner, so a leaked `pk_` cannot be reused for other maps. | `sig=Jx3w0b2kQnVt9yRmZsLc4u8hAe1pDfGo` |
| `exp` | Optional expiry of a signed URL (Unix seconds). Covered by the signature. | `exp=1798761600` |

## Request headers

Headers marked *keys* exist only when the server runs with API keys (the hosted service).

| Header | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `Authorization` *keys* | Secret key for server-to-server calls: `Bearer sk_…`. | `Bearer sk_…` |
| `X-Provider-Key` | Key for a commercial basemap style (`style=`); kept out of URLs and logs. | `your-maptiler-key` |
| `X-Routing-Key` | Key for openrouteservice / GraphHopper routing; kept out of URLs and logs. | `your-ors-key` |
| `X-Request-Id` | Optional id for this request (letters, digits, `._:-`, ≤ 64 chars), e.g. from your proxy; otherwise the server generates one. | `3f2c9a1e-…` |
| `If-None-Match` | Send a previous `ETag` to get `304 Not Modified` when the image is unchanged. | `"e1b4…png"` |

## Response headers

Headers marked *keys* exist only when the server runs with API keys (the hosted service).

| Header | Description | Example |
|---|---|---|
| `ETag` | Content hash of the image (also its cache key). | `"e1b4d02…7b6.png"` |
| `Cache-Control` | Rendered maps may be cached for a day; `/v1/images/{key}` is immutable. | `public, max-age=86400` |
| `X-Cache` | `HIT` when served from the image cache, `MISS` when rendered for this request. | `HIT` |
| `X-Render-Ms` | Render time in milliseconds (on a `MISS`). | `212` |
| `X-Image-Width` | Final pixel width. Can exceed `w × scale` when `neighborfit=extend` grew the image. | `556` |
| `X-Image-Height` | Final pixel height. | `296` |
| `Retry-After` | Seconds to wait after a `503 busy` or `429` response. | `2` |
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` *keys* | Requests per minute allowed for this key's plan. | `120` |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` *keys* | Requests left in the current window. | `117` |
| `X-RateLimit-Reset` *keys* | Unix seconds when the window is full again. | `1798761660` |
| `X-Quota-Remaining` *keys* | Renders left this calendar month (UTC). Cache hits do not count. | `24120` |
| `X-Request-Id` | Id of this request; also in every error body as `requestId` and in the server logs. Quote it in support requests. | `3f2c9a1e-7b1d-4c0e-9a55-0d2f6e8b1c44` |
| `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` | CORS: images and JSON can be fetched from any origin. | `*` |
